    sessionAuthenticated: () => true,
    originAndCsrfValid: () => true,
    fundCodeActive: () => true,

  };
  const taBridgeSettlementExterns: TaBridgeSettlementExternPorts = {
    submissionPinned: () => true,

    taOutcomeRejected: () => true,
    taAbsenceConfirmed: () => true,
    ...(overrides.taBridgeSettlement ?? {}),
  };
  const taBridgeSettlementEffects: TaBridgeSettlementEffectsPort = {
    pin(artifact, inputs) { store.pin(artifact, inputs); recorded.push({ kind: "pin", target: artifact, payload: inputs }); },
    dispatch(target, payload) { store.recordDispatch(target, payload); recorded.push({ kind: "dispatch", target, payload }); },
  };
  return {
